caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

VR isn't magic, it's just really clever science! Your brain is the real magician here.

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 VR headsets show a slightly different flat image to each of your eyes.
🔹 Just like how you see the real world, but digitally!
🔹 Your brain then cleverly stitches these two images together.
🔹 This creates the powerful illusion of a deep, three-dimensional world, making you feel truly immersed!
